title: Deepseek V4.1 Flash 1017 beats larger rivals in agentic tasks while once again massively cutting per-task costs
summary: DeepSeek 在本期窗口推出 V4.1-Flash-1017，模型已进入网页、App、API，并公开权重；同时开放 Search 和 Fetch API。性能提升与任务成本比较来自厂商评测，尚需独立复测。
investorNote: 模型的任务级完成成本比单纯token单价更值得测；搜索接口会影响开发者是否把DeepSeek接入完整Agent流程。

evidence.quote:
Deepseek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is available now through the company's website, app, and API. Deepseek also published the model weights as open source on
Hugging Face
and
ModelScope
. Compared to its direct predecessor, the model posts better benchmark scores, finishes tasks faster, and produces shorter outputs. The company calls the update a Pareto improvement in the tradeoff between performance and cost.

Each endpoint costs $0.75 per 1,000 calls. Deepseek API users can access the features for free through server-side tools in Deepseek Harness, Claude Code, and Codex until October 31, 2026 (4:00 PM UTC).

displayTitle: DeepSeek 更新 V4.1-Flash，并向开发者开放搜索接口
narrative: DeepSeek 上线 V4.1-Flash-1017，并向开发者开放 Search 与 Fetch API。The Decoder 报道模型已进入网页、App 和 API，权重也已公开；每千次搜索调用报价 0.75 美元，现有 API 用户经 Harness 工具调用在指定期限内可免费试用。厂商称新版在编程和长任务上更快、更省，投资判断仍应看独立任务完成率与真实总成本，而非只看其自评榜单。

eventRelation.reason: 本窗口内发布的新模型版本与搜索接口，历史目录未见相同具体发布
